notes.title: We have tested our metal!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! Thanks to all of you that joined the Goblin Gladiators playtest on 23/06!

We had a fantastic time playing with you all for what was a great test of the game for both us and our servers, and we got some amazing insight from everyone too! However, we need to take a break on the remaining playtests to look at some technical issues that came up during the session and we will update you all when we have resolved those.

In the meantime, keep the game installed and we'll be back soon! If you want to keep up to date with everything Goblin Gladiators, join us on Discord: (https://discord.gg/cRFf5pG78a).

See you in the arena ...soon!
